APP_URL.description: Public origin for webhook payload URLs. **Leave unset** to use this deployment's own origin automatically; set it when serving behind a custom domain or for mirror deployments.

DB.description: D1 database holding all relational metadata: users, orgs, repos, issues, pull requests, webhooks.

REPO_PACKS.description: R2 bucket storing git packs, objects, LFS blobs and editor upload staging.

ASSETS.description: Static asset binding serving the built Gitea frontend tree (`pnpm build:assets`).

REPO.description: Durable Object (`RepoCell`) — per-repository git storage engine and write serialization.

REGISTRY.description: Durable Object (`Registry`) — repository index resolving owner/slug to repo cells.

WEBHOOK_DELIVERY.description: Queue carrying webhook delivery jobs from emission to the delivery consumer.

REPO_TASKS.description: Queue driving background repo work: delete purge, import indexing, mirror syncs.

MIRROR_SYNC_QUEUE.description: Queue producer alias for mirror-sync messages, multiplexed onto the same consumer as `REPO_TASKS`.
